body: ### Summary Latest uv version. I am installing uv via winget on windows 11, with an already installed python version of 3.14 in the powershell. It says successfull installation but when i try to call uv in the powershell it fails in a generic way. I know uv has problems with windows AV software. But is this the reason here? Is somebody having the same troubles? I only want to use uv bc it is needed in https://github.com/AlbusChen/GameForge-Harness#requirements. So if anybody knows a unity harness which does not use uv. I would be satisfied. ### Platform Windows11 ### Version uv latest ### Python version 3.13.14
title: Naming of uv not found as a cmdlet, function, scriptfile, executable program
